criteria: SDSS DR18 PhotoPrimary type=3 (galaxy), mode=1, clean=1; dbo.fGetNearbyObjEq at <=2.0 arcsec, independently recomputed great-circle separation <=2 arcsec.
limitations: SDSS imaging footprint only; not a full LS DR10 or all-sky sample.
The SDSS morphological galaxy tag and 2 arcsec centroids are provisional; 4XMM EP_EXTENT/PN exposure, Gaia/star, known blazars and multiple matches remain to be vetoed.
No EPIC-pn light curves or candidate vetting was performed in this stage.
